name: Star
overview: Scripture reveals that stars are part of God's deliberate creation, serving as lights in the heavens to mark time and seasons, as seen in Genesis 1:14. The stars are not objects of worship but are under God's sovereign control, who has assigned them to nations and named each one, demonstrating His authority and care (Deuteronomy 4:19; Psalms 147:4). The stars also inspire awe as the work of God's fingers, reflecting His creative power (Psalms 8:3). The appearance of a special star at Christ's birth guided the wise men, highlighting God's providential guidance in history (Matthew 2:1).
